All queries verified! Here are my final answers for the qlang usability experiment:

M1: filter ~(/active | eq true) | filter ~(at :email | ne null) | * (/email | lower) | sort

M2: * (at :profile !| null | at :age !| null | if (type | eq ::number) ~(/) ~(null)) | filter ~(ne null) | [(sum) (count)] | :vec / | (vec | /0 | div (vec | /1) | round 1)

M3: * (at :profile !| null | at :country !| null | if (ne null) ~(upper) ~(null)) | filter ~(ne null) | groupBy ~(/) | * count

M4: filter ~(and (/state | eq "open") (/labels | any ~(lower | eq "bug"))) | sort ~([(mul /priority -1) /id]) | take 2 | * /id

M5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | * (at :assignee | coalesce "unassigned") | groupBy ~(/) | * count

M6: * /labels | flat | * lower | distinct | sort

M7: /dependencies | entries | * {:name (/0 | keyword) :version (/1 | if (or (startsWith "^") (startsWith "~")) ~(drop 1) ~(/))} | sort ~(/name)

M8: filter ~(or (/status | eq "paid") (/status | eq "shipped")) | * (/items | * (mul /qty /price) | sum) | sum | round 2

M9: filter ~(/status | ne "cancelled") | * {:customer /customer :total (/items | * (mul /qty /price) | sum)} | groupBy ~(/customer) | entries | * {:customer (/0 | keyword) :total (/1 | * /total | sum | round 2)} | sort ~([(mul /total -1) /customer]) | take 2

M10: /services | entries | filter ~(/1 | at :tls !| null | at :enabled !| null | eq true) | * {:name (/0 | keyword) :service /1} | sort ~(/name) | * (/service | :svc / | (svc | /host | append ":" | append (svc | at :port | coalesce 80 | print)))

M11: split "\n" | filter ~(ne "") | * (split " " | if (/1 | eq "ERROR") ~(/2) ~(null)) | filter ~(ne null) | groupBy ~(/) | * count

M12: split "\n" | filter ~(ne "") | * (split " ") | filter ~(or (/1 | eq "WARN") (/1 | eq "ERROR")) | filter ~(drop 3 | join " " | lower | contains "timeout") | * /2 | distinct | sort

M13: split "\n" | filter ~(ne "") | drop 1 | * (split ",") | * {:dept /1 :salary (/2 | if (ne "") ~(parseJson) ~(null))} | filter ~(/salary | ne null) | groupBy ~(/dept) | entries | * {:dept (/0 | keyword) :avg (/1 | [( * /salary | sum) ( * /salary | count)] | :vec / | (vec | /0 | div (vec | /1) | round 0))}

M14: "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. The dog sleeps; the fox runs. A fox is quick." | split " " | * (split "." | first | split ";" | first) | filter ~(ne "") | * lower | groupBy ~(/) | entries | * {:word (/0 | keyword) :count (/1 | count)} | sort ~([(mul /count -1) /word]) | take 3
